observation: Butterfly valves were installed on the suction header of the main electric and diesel fire water pumps.
recommendation: Replace butterfly valves on the pump suction header with listed Outside Screw and Yoke (OS&Y) gate valves to ensure an unobstructed flow path and prevent cavitation.
system_efficacy_context: Butterfly disc obstructs suction flow and induces turbulence under high flow demand.

observation: Y-strainers were not installed on the flooded suction line between the static fire water tank and fire pumps.
recommendation: Install corrosion-resistant Y-strainers on the suction line of each fire pump set to arrest debris and prevent impeller damage.

observation: Mechanical foam type portable fire extinguishers were not provided near the diesel day tank inside the DG room.
recommendation: Provide 9-liter mechanical foam type portable fire extinguishers near the diesel storage area inside the DG room for Class B hydrocarbon fire suppression.

observation: Diesel day tanks lacked a secondary containment dyke wall capable of holding 110% of tank volume.
recommendation: Construct an impervious secondary containment dyke around the diesel day tank with net holding capacity equal to at least 110% of the tank volume.

observation: Wet-pipe water sprinkler heads were installed directly above energized medium-voltage electrical switchgear panels.
recommendation: Remove water-based suppression systems from energized electrical switchgear rooms and provide clean-agent in-panel flooding suppression to eliminate electrocution hazards.
system_efficacy_context: Water suppression above energized MV/HV equipment creates severe electrocution and arc-flash risk.

observation: Point smoke detectors were not installed inside ceiling bays formed by structural beams exceeding 10% of ceiling height.
recommendation: Relocate and add smoke detectors inside each structural beam pocket exceeding 10% of overall ceiling height to eliminate dead-air detection zones.
system_efficacy_context: Deep ceiling beams trap rising smoke plumes, delaying detector actuation.

observation: High-piled storage racks exceeding 4.2 meters in height lacked in-rack automatic sprinkler protection.
recommendation: Install in-rack automatic fire sprinklers compliant with hazard density calculations where combustible rack storage exceeds 3.7 meters.

observation: Point-type optical smoke detectors were installed at a 14-meter shed ceiling height where stratification prevents reliable response.
recommendation: Replace point smoke detectors in ceilings exceeding 10 meters with projected optical beam detectors or aspirating smoke detection systems.
system_efficacy_context: Point smoke detectors are disqualified above 10 m ceiling height under IS 2189.

observation: Concealed false ceiling voids measuring 950 mm in depth lacked above-ceiling smoke detectors.
recommendation: Install concealed smoke detectors with external response indicators above false ceilings wherever void depth exceeds 800 mm.
system_efficacy_context: Concealed cable trays above 800 mm voids remain unmonitored.

observation: No hydrogen gas leak detection system was installed in the enclosed VRLA battery charging room.
recommendation: Install ceiling-mounted hydrogen (H2) gas leak detectors interlocked with mechanical exhaust ventilation in the battery room.
